Done. The fix and regression tests are in place, and the suite passes.

## Change

**`src/context.ts:768-785`** — `Context#redirect` now guarantees the `Location` value contains no raw CR/LF:

- Kept the existing encoding selection at `src/context.ts:773-776` (`encodeURI` only when the string contains chars above `\xFF`), so valid ASCII URLs and already percent-encoded sequences like `%0D%0A` are not double-encoded, and multibyte paths still encode as before.
- Added a uniform sanitization step at `src/context.ts:782`: `encodedLocation.replace(/[\r\n]/g, (char) => (char === '\r' ? '%0D' : '%0A'))`, so literal CR and LF become `%0D`/`%0A` before `Headers.set` is reached. `encodeURI` output is unaffected since it emits no literal CR/LF.

## Tests

**`src/context.test.ts:118-142`** — four new regression tests:

| Test | Assertion |
|---|---|
| raw LF (`/destination\nevil`) | `Location === /destination%0Aevil`, status 302 |
| raw CR (`/destination\revil`) | `Location === /destination%0Devil` |
| CRLF injection payload (`\r\nSet-Cookie: injected=1`) | `Location === /destination%0D%0ASet-Cookie: injected=1`, `Set-Cookie` is `null` |
| already percent-encoded input (`%0D%0A…`) | preserved verbatim, `Set-Cookie` is `null` |

Existing valid-redirect tests (relative URL, absolute URL, `URL` object, multibyte, and the four `unchangedURLString` cases at `src/context.test.ts:144-156`) remain untouched and passing.
